LanguageData.RHA_V22_Rules: Draft branch cards for a colonist who owns the core. Each core uses one branch at a time. Switch freely after undrafting, stopping the spin and spending 10 seconds without attacks, casts or enemy hits. Ammo and cooldowns are retained.

LanguageData.RHA_V22_CombatLock: Undraft and remain out of combat for 10 seconds before switching
LanguageData.RHA_V22_CanSwitch: Switching is available. Other acquired branches are kept.

LanguageData.RHA_V22_EscortHint: Choose a friendly humanlike colonist on this map. The projection follows normal paths. Relay coverage pauses outside its short link range.
